svg.aria-label: When a provider stops answering. Null passes your backup order to OMP through a separate configuration overlay. The order goes before the existing model and provider-specific entries for the run, and your own OMP settings are not modified. OMP decides when to retry or fall back and resends the message itself. Fallback can follow a refusal or a sign-in failure as well as a usage limit. The box reports detected model switches and highlights failed replies, but it never resends one: recall it with the up arrow or type it again. Failure detection uses OMP's end-of-turn token-usage signal, an unstable protocol extension. The fallback path has been exercised with simulated failures; real account-limit behavior is still awaiting verification.
